method: Administrative exact Git byte readback, file hashing, frozen-manifest expansion and existing log/row parsing only. Local terminal directories are hash-bound by the specified directory-digest recipe; their full raw bytes are not represented as remotely published.

entries.timing: Review-time hash only; not in239-entry pre-call manifest
Review-time hash only; not in239-entry pre-call manifest

entries.digest_recipe: Walk regular files recursively, reject symlinks; sort relative POSIX paths lexicographically; SHA256 UTF8 compact JSON array of [relative_path,byte_count,sha256_file] tuples; no trailing newline.
